description: culture-rules#124: repodocs.sync's library is culture-library (library.culture.dev), reached on spark's loopback; the repos are the top-level checkouts under repos_root on spark, so the actor lives on spark. The key is a write key whose kinds are exactly spec, plan, devague-record and design, minted with culture-library keys mint --name culture-rules-repodocs --scope write --kind spec --kind plan --kind devague-record --kind design --private and stored in grant as LIBRARY_REPODOCS_PUSH_API_KEY. state_path holds what was last pushed (so an unchanged cycle sends nothing); max_seconds bounds one run, and the next run resumes. See docs/operations/repodocs.md.
name: Culture library (repo documents)
